reason: The focus ring is drawn in code with CSS outline (outline-2, a bare 2px width). Tailwind's theme has no variable for outline widths, so there is none in Figma to bind it to; the export still records the 2px, and expectToMatchFigma compares it with the rendered outline-width.

The focus ring's size follows the button through its stretch constraints (2px outside each edge), so it can't be a variable: it differs per size and per label. In code it is the outline's offset (outline-offset-2) around the button's own box, which expectToMatchFigma measures.
